# Drawer tabs and Add screenshots

Real shared iOS Simulator captures for #2175, 402 × 874, English. Before and after use the same retained QA computer and signed-out public UAT configuration; there are no credentials in these images. The service address shown is the public UAT endpoint.

The before view combines both lists and three direct actions. The after views show Computers and Cloud separately and the new Add chooser. The chooser has no old modal counterpart: the old direct actions are its before state. `proof.json` binds source, integrated batch and native identities.

Navigation checks reached the invitation and pairing pages without signing in, accepting an invitation or changing pairing. Maximum-text images show wrapping and a scrollable chooser; they do not establish a complete accessibility matrix. A nested native-modal route observation remains open in the proof; Android, physical phone and Human QA are unverified. The shared environment was restored after capture.
